row.title: DISPOSE-1 first live pass broke the pins check; dispositions now prune the baseline
row.body: The first fleet pass closed 11 gated roadmap rows that doctrine/pins-baseline.json still listed, so main failed pins --check. foundation/dispose.py now removes a disposed item from that baseline in the same pass, using pins.unprobed as the reading; test_dispose.py covers it.
